keyFindings.description: The architect's required change. The new step race-tests only ./cmd/listener/. This PR's new concurrency also lives in ./internal/store (the role-holder map, holdersMu, the epoch fence) and ./internal/kvwatch (completeness, WithRescan), and no race step in any workflow covers either package. That is why a race in this PR's code reached a tester and not CI. Add ./internal/store/ and ./internal/kvwatch/... to the race step.

The envoy-go-race job keeps timeout-minutes: 45, and its first race step takes 12-18 min in recent runs. The new step's -timeout 30m can therefore never fire: the runner cancels the job first, so a hung listener test never prints Go's timeout dump naming the stuck test. Raise the job's timeout-minutes to cover both steps plus compile (about 60, more once store and kvwatch join), or lower the step's -timeout below what the job leaves.
